decision.broad_expansion_gate: Two positive platforms and one exact route authorize targeted priority-queue expansion, not exhaustive or indiscriminate LNPDB mining.
decision.next_stage: Expand only through the frozen source-paper priority queue, beginning with native-Ugi JC_2023 and then high-value transfer sources, while measuring weighted motif and candidate-route closure.
decision.reason: Two independent non-Ugi platforms provide exact source-reaction-linked mappings to novel, frozen-transform-compatible Ugi components while source reactions, target-handle routes, biological applicability, and route closure remain separate.

stopping_policy.lnpdb_role: Define and prioritize the tail-motif census, not the complete reaction universe.
metrics: candidate-route closure with substantive rejections separated from missing knowledge
marginal route-coverage gain across consecutive curation rounds
complete prospective-panel dossiers with backup routes for the riskiest precursors
stopping_policy.numeric_threshold_status: Freeze exact thresholds before generator-driven curation and final prospective selection; do not choose them retrospectively.
stopping_policy.objective: Stop when missing route knowledge no longer materially constrains the biologically relevant Ugi-3 design space under the declared support and oracle-applicability policies.
tiers: close every permitted native Ugi-3 component and locked control
transfer high-value motifs from other lipid platforms
fill repeated route-knowledge gaps exposed by biologically competitive generated candidates
leave chemistry irrelevant to the declared Ugi-3 paper scope uncurated
